description: Use this to fully replace service assignments for staffId in salonId with serviceIds. Previews current and proposed assignments; an empty list removes assignments when applied. For native catalogs, accounts for implicit assignments of services to all staff and their materialization across the salon. Saves a plan without changing assignments; apply with beautyos_apply_change only after explicit confirmation of all effects.
name: beautyos_staff_services_replace_prepare
title: Prepare staff service replacement
